one_liner.text: Tell KryptoLens what matters. Give it a job. It keeps watch for you.

description.text: A persistent crypto intelligence workspace: users create Agents (UI name for a Lens), give them natural-language market jobs, and leave those jobs running against CoinMarketCap data with a structured Plan → Evidence → Verification → Result log.
conflicts: kept verified text; incoming inferred differed

problem.text: Someone who can name a crypto-market job in language wants a teammate that stays on it, not a dashboard they have to configure.

solution.text: A Lens is a persistent crypto agent with a compiled job, workflow, routines, tool permissions, conversation, and results; AgentRuntime plans then LensRuntime/workflow hits live CMC and writes verified results back.
conflicts: kept verified text; incoming inferred differed

users.text: A researcher or operator who can name a crypto-market job in language and wants an unattended teammate on live CoinMarketCap data.

description.text: A Lens is a user-owned persistent crypto agent with name, purpose, natural-language request, status (draft/active/paused), versions, routines, conversation, and results.

implemented.text: Lens and LensVersion models persist job_definition_json, policy_json, workflow_json, and tool_permissions_json; views create agents from intent via AgentService.

description.text: Authenticated users describe a job; ConversationService handles intent/actions on the lens detail page, including run, preview, and draft diffs.

implemented.text: lens_create POSTs intent to AgentService.create_from_intent; lens_detail POSTs to ConversationService.handle; LensRuntime.handle_instruction applies intent edits.

description.text: Chief Agent emits a schema-validated AgentPlan (monitor/investigate/research) with allowed steps and tools; plans do not call CMC.

implemented.text: AgentPlan validation rejects unknown steps/tools and unavailable specialists with executable steps; AgentRuntime persists the plan as a conversation artifact.

description.text: WorkflowDefinition allows a fixed step set (universe/listings, quotes, global metrics, fear & greed, calculate, sort, filter, aggregate, present) and optional asset_condition triggers.

implemented.text: execute_steps dispatches permitted CMC tools, normalizes listings, can exclude stablecoins, and rejects unknown calculations; arbitrary code step types are rejected.

description.text: AgentRuntime wraps LensRuntime in PLAN → ACT → OBSERVE → VERIFY → REPAIR? → COMPLETE, sharing Check now and scheduled paths.

implemented.text: Celery run_lens constructs AgentRuntime; manual/historical/chat use run_now, scheduled uses trigger_routine; LensRuntime falls back to MonitoringService when a workflow has no steps.

description.text: Celery task run_active_lenses enqueues due routines via RoutineService; run_lens executes the same AgentRuntime path as manual checks.

implemented.text: Compose defines a beat service; run_active_lenses delays run_lens(lens_id, 'scheduled') for each due routine. 15-minute cadence is documented, not shown in task code.
conflicts: README claims a 15-minute cadence; monitoring tasks evidence does not set Beat interval.

description.text: Check-now style runs can return an HTMX run_status partial or JSON {run_id, stage}.

implemented.text: _run_response renders workspace/partials/run_status.html on HX-Request or JsonResponse with run_id and stage.

description.text: Default permissions allow four CMC read tools and deny news and on_chain.

implemented.text: require_tool raises ToolPermissionError for news, on_chain, unknown, or disabled tools; dispatch_cmc maps only CMC handlers.

architecture.text: Django monolith: users, lenses, intelligence, monitoring, events, notifications, cmc. Human intent → Chief Agent AgentPlan → validated Workflow → AgentRuntime wrapping LensRuntime → CMCAdapter. Celery worker/beat share run_lens. WhiteNoise + Django templates.

stack.text: Django 5.1–<5.3 with custom AUTH_USER_MODEL users.User, sessions, CSRF, WhiteNoise, humanize.
Celery + django-celery-beat + Redis broker for worker and beat.
Pydantic v2 models for AgentPlan, WorkflowDefinition, JobDefinition, IntelligencePolicy.
httpx client for CoinMarketCap Pro API.
Gunicorn (requirements) behind nginx:1.27 on host 8080 in compose.

dependencies.text: djangorestframework>=3.15,<3.17 is listed; no REST view usage appears in this pack.
pytest, pytest-django, pytest-cov, respx for tests
Optional cursor-sdk when CURSOR_API_KEY is set (commented in requirements).

claim.text: CMCAdapter calls https://pro-api.coinmarketcap.com for listings/latest, quotes/latest, historical quotes/listings, using CMC_API_KEY and optional as_of historical mode.
DATABASE_URL can use PostgreSQL; settings rewrite IPv6-only db.<ref>.supabase.co hosts to an IPv4 pooler on port 6543.
Compose and web/worker/beat set REDIS_URL redis://redis:6379/0.
LensRuntime and AgentRuntime import telegram notify helpers (notify_event, notify_result, notify_artifact). Connect/test/disconnect UI is documented only.
Outbound CMC listings latest used by get_listings / get_market_listings.
Outbound CMC quotes latest used by get_quotes.
Outbound CMC historical quotes when adapter as_of is set.
Accepts application/json (without HTML) returns {run_id, stage} for a lens run. Exact URL path not in pack.

database.text: Default SQLite at db.sqlite3; PostgreSQL when DATABASE_URL is set (Django ENGINE postgresql, pooler-aware CONN_MAX_AGE/DISABLE_SERVER_SIDE_CURSORS on 6543). Compose runs postgres:16-alpine database kryptolens. Core models include Lens, LensVersion, LensRun plus AgentRuntime imports of Job, Result, Artifact, Evidence, AgentTask, ApprovalRequest, VerificationRecord.

auth.text: Custom users.User; Django AuthenticationMiddleware; lens views require login_required and scope objects with Lens.objects.filter(..., user=request.user). README infers /signup, /login, and built-in password reset.

deployment.text: Docker image from python:3.12-slim, entrypoint docker/entrypoint.sh, expose 8000. Compose: postgres, redis, web, worker, beat, nginx 8080→80. Env via .env plus DATABASE_URL and REDIS_URL.

implemented_functionality.text: Lens versioning stores policy, job definition, workflow, tool permissions, and compile report JSON; LensRun tracks stages from queued through fetching_cmc, verifying, repairing, notifying, complete/error.
AgentService.create_from_intent / create_draft / select / activate used by login-required lens views.
Workflow validator rejects unknown steps and explicitly blocks eval/exec/code/http.
trigger_fired compares an asset observation metric against WorkflowTrigger operator/value using intelligence.engine.compare.
If a version workflow has no steps, LensRuntime delegates to MonitoringService.run_lens.
Adapter as_of switches listings/quotes to historical CMC endpoints and stamps LensRun trigger historical.
AgentRuntime writes plan and status_update conversation items; LensRuntime records CMC activity, results, and errors.

runtime.text: Local/dev DEBUG defaults to on; ALLOWED_HOSTS localhost/127.0.0.1. Compose runtime is web+worker+beat+postgres+redis+nginx. No live process evidence in this pack (tests array empty, no runtime kind).

demo_opportunities.text: Create an Agent from a template or intent, chat a market job, Check now, and show HTMX stage plus CMC-backed result.
Show conversation artifacts Plan → Evidence → Verification → Result as AgentRuntime executes.
Ask for news/on-chain/wallet work and show permission/specialist unavailable refusal.

marketing.text: Positioned as a persistent crypto intelligence teammate, not a chatbot, dashboard, demo, or trading bot. Voice: Tell → Define → Watch → Act → Return. Quiet markets are a valid result.

hackathon.text: Built for CoinMarketCap Build with CMC hackathon, track AI Agents and Automation, tag #BuildwithCMC.
